summary: Iran launched two ballistic missiles from Kurdistan Province and reported explosions in the Strait of Hormuz, while UAV activity was detected near the Iraqi border. The US deployed a third carrier strike group to CENTCOM as Houthis seized a strategic base in Lahj, Yemen, advancing toward Aden. Israel conducted an airstrike on a police station west of Rafah, wounding two, and artillery shelling continued in southern Lebanon.
key_points: Iran launched two ballistic missiles from Qorveh, Kurdistan Province, per monitoring reports. (Source: @shin_persian/12420)
Explosions were heard in the Strait of Hormuz, Hormozgan Province, Iran. (Source: @shin_persian/12416)
USS Theodore Roosevelt entered CENTCOM waters, joining two other US carrier strike groups in the region. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10078)
Houthis seized Kharaz military base in Lahj, Yemen, advancing toward Aden as government troops retreated. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10066)
Israeli airstrike hit a police station west of Rafah, southern Gaza, wounding two according to Arab media. (Source: @yediotnews25/137861)
Artillery shelling and Israeli flare drops reported over Zoutar Al-Sharqiyah and Wadi Al-Hajir in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/53405)
Three strong explosions occurred in Jurf al-Sakhar, Iraq, cause unclear; Iraqi PM removed nine officials over oil smuggling. (Source: @shin_persian/12413)
Jordanian Navy detained a suspect attempting to swim from Israel to Jordan in the Gulf of Aqaba. (Source: @manniefabian/59522)

sections.executive_summary: Iran launched two ballistic missiles from Kurdistan Province and reported explosions in the Strait of Hormuz, signaling heightened military activity. The US bolstered its naval presence with a third carrier strike group entering CENTCOM as Houthis captured a strategic Yemeni base near Aden. Israel struck a Gaza police station and continued artillery operations in southern Lebanon amid ongoing multi-front tensions.

points: Two ballistic missiles were launched from Qorveh in Kurdistan Province, Iran, detected by monitoring systems with a 120-second delay. (Source: @shin_persian/12420)
Sounds of explosions were reported in the Strait of Hormuz, Hormozgan Province, Iran, per delayed incident reporting. (Source: @shin_persian/12416)
UAV activity was observed over the Iraqi border in West Azerbaijan Province at 21:02 local time (1732Z). (Source: @shin_persian/12411)
Air defense systems were launched from Qeshm Island, Iran, according to intelligence channel reports. (Source: @shin_persian/12408)
Further UAV activity occurred over Urmia, Sardasht, and Piranshahr in West Azerbaijan Province at 22:47 local time (1917Z). (Source: @shin_persian/12418)
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi was en route to Islamabad, Pakistan, aboard a government aircraft (EP-IGF, callsign IRAN05). (Source: @shin_persian/12415)
An engagement between IRGC forces and the Kurdish dissident group PJAK near the Iran-Iraq border resulted in one PJAK fighter killed; Iranian casualties unconfirmed. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10074)
Israeli warplanes conducted an airstrike on a police station west of Rafah in southern Gaza, wounding two people according to Arab media reports. (Source: @yediotnews25/137861)
Israeli forces detained AFP video journalist Mohammad Ateeq in the occupied West Bank on suspicion of links to terrorism; AFP demands proof. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10073)
Israeli warplanes were reported flying over southern Lebanon, per Lebanese monitoring channels. (Source: @redlinkleb/53392)
The Likud party requested Gadi Eisenkot postpone the Knesset speaker vote as a goodwill gesture; Eisenkot refused immediately. (Source: @yediotnews25/137866)
Political negotiations continued between Likud, Yesh Atid, and Bennett representatives regarding potential unity government formation. (Source: @amitsegal/67226)
Israeli airstrike targeted a police station west of Rafah in southern Gaza, resulting in two wounded per Arab media. (Source: @yediotnews25/137861)

Britain, Australia, Canada, and Italy jointly urged Israel to open Gaza crossings, stating 150,000 tents and essential supplies remain blocked as winter flooding worsens. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10072)
Israeli forces detained AFP journalist Mohammad Ateeq in the West Bank on terrorism suspicions; AFP demands evidence. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10073)
No additional Gaza or West Bank military operations were explicitly detailed in the provided messages beyond the Rafah strike and detention.
Artillery shelling struck Zoutar Al-Sharqiyah in southern Lebanon, with multiple impacts reported on live maps. (Source: @redlinkleb/53405)
Israeli forces dropped illumination flares over Zoutar Al-Sharqiyah, per Lebanese army alerts. (Source: @redlinkleb/53395)
Artillery shelling also hit Wadi Al-Hajir area in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/53394)
Lebanese army warned residents of Zoutar Al-Sharqiyah to avoid the town square due to a possible explosion threat. (Source: @redlinkleb/53381)
Israeli warplanes were observed over southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/53392)
Red Alert Lebanon solicited donations to maintain early warning services. (Source: @redlinkleb/53388)
Three very strong explosions occurred in Jurf al-Sakhar, Iraq; cause remains unclear per local reports. (Source: @shin_persian/12413)

Iraqi PM Al-Zaidi confirmed the Jurf al-Sakhar committee verified oil smuggling, referred suspects to judiciary, and removed nine officials including PMF Babil commander and Babil police chief. (Source: @shin_persian/12407)
IRGC engaged Kurdish dissident group PJAK near the Iran-Iraq border; PJAK confirmed one fighter killed, Iranian casualties unknown. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10074)
UAV activity was detected over the Iraqi border in Iran's West Azerbaijan Province. (Source: @shin_persian/12411)
Jordanian Royal Navy detained a suspect attempting to swim from Israel into Jordanian territorial waters in the Gulf of Aqaba; suspect transferred to authorities. (Source: @manniefabian/59522)

USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) entered CENTCOM waters, creating three US carrier strike groups in the region alongside USS George H.W. Bush and USS George Washington. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10078)
Saudi Royal Saudi Air Force conducted airstrikes on Houthi-controlled Sana'a, Yemen. (Source: @shin_persian/12409)
Houthis released 600 detainees in Sana'a unilaterally, outside the Stockholm agreement; ICRC interviewed each privately before release. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10070)
Houthis seized the strategic Kharaz military base in Lahj, Yemen, advancing toward Aden; government troops reportedly retreated. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10066)

Explosions reported in the Strait of Hormuz, Hormozgan Province, a critical global oil chokepoint. (Source: @shin_persian/12416)
US naval power surged with USS Theodore Roosevelt joining two other carriers in CENTCOM, totaling three strike groups. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10078)
Houthis captured Kharaz base in Lahj, Yemen, advancing toward Aden after government forces withdrew. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10066)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran's ballistic missile launches from Kurdistan Province and explosions in the Strait of Hormuz suggest heightened military posture, possibly signaling deterrence or readiness. The tripling of US carrier strike groups in CENTCOM indicates preparation for potential escalation, particularly regarding Iranian-backed threats to maritime traffic. Houthi seizure of Kharaz base near Aden threatens Bab al-Mandab shipping lanes, while Saudi airstrikes on Sana'a show continued Gulf coalition pressure. Israel's simultaneous operations in Gaza and Lebanon reflect a multi-front strategy, but political deadlock in Jerusalem may constrain military decision-making.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are actively responding: Saudi Arabia strikes Houthi targets in Sana'a, Jordan intercepts border infiltrators from Israel, and Iraq's government purges Iran-linked officials in Jurf al-Sakhar. The US naval buildup signals commitment to freedom of navigation and deterrence against Iranian aggression. International pressure mounts on Israel to open Gaza crossings for humanitarian aid as winter approaches. Lebanon's civil defense systems remain active amid ongoing Israeli artillery and overflights.
sections.intelligence_notes: The 120-second delayed reporting from Iranian monitoring channels (FromIran) provides near-real-time detection of missile launches and UAV activity, suggesting robust open-source intelligence coverage. Concurrent UAV flights over West Azerbaijan and explosions in Jurf al-Sakhar may indicate IRGC operations against Kurdish groups or border security measures. Iranian FM Araghchi's travel to Pakistan could signal diplomatic coordination amid regional tensions. The absence of confirmed Iranian casualties in the PJAK clash warrants monitoring for escalation patterns.
